text:
tess: Heads up — brought up a compact embed called nightjar-mini (6-layer) quantized int8 per-channel into staging. Quick sanity run against our short-query holdout shows odd nearest neighbors for a couple domains. Posting initial findings.

omar: numbers?

tess: recall@1 vs baseline heron-v2 (fp16): -1.9%. recall@10: -0.7%. Clustering silhouette avg dropped 0.16 -> 0.08.

jing: that's larger than i'd expect for per-channel int8. Did you run with the same normalization?

tess: yes, l2 norm before index + cosine sim. Same pipeline. I also verified tokenizer/parsing identical.

neil: could this be a length effect? short-query holdout skews <=6 tokens which can be brittle. Split by length?

eval-bot: scheduled quick stratified eval: job 3809991150 (buckets: <=6, 7-20, >20).

cassie: any qualitative examples? helps debugging.

omar: pasted 3 redacted examples: 
- q: "renew trademark deadline" -> nightjar-mini top1: "how to renew subscription" (wrong intent) ; heron top1: "trademark renewal deadline and forms" 
- q: "graphql mutation returns null" -> nightjar top3 includes unrelated auth doc; heron returns mutation schema notes 
- q: "refund policy exceptions" -> nightjar top1: "return label generation" (surface match) vs heron: "refund exceptions and eligibility"

jing: looks like surface token overlap wins in nightjar-mini. Could be head weights skewed after quant.

neil: try running with cosine temp scaling or re-normalize per-batch. Sometimes scale drift after quant changes distance magnitudes.

cassie: also run a mixed-precision variant where final projection layer is fp16 (only keep earlier layers int8). We've seen that preserve semantic structure in other models.

omar: i can build that config. will produce an artifact in ~1hr. which eval to run? short-holdout + legal & api topical slices.

tess: run short-holdout + topic-slices mentioned. Also generate top-5 diffs vs baseline so we can human-review big movers.

eval-bot: noted. job queued: 3809991160. diff extraction job 3809991165.

jing: FYI, i re-ran nightjar-mini with per-tensor int8 just to check; it was worse (recall@1 -3.7%). so per-channel was better but still off.

omar: mixed-precision build finished. initial numbers: recall@1 gap reduced to -0.6%, recall@10 -0.2%. silhouette delta now -0.03.

cassie: excellent. can we get a small human eval on the 40 top movers? i'll coordinate reviewers (legal, api, support).

tess: done — prepared top-40 and uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/nightjar-mini/3809991111/top40_diff.jsonl. tagged reviewers.

neil: one more check: index quantization sometimes interacts with vector lengths. confirm ANN index used identical parameters (ef_search / HNSW M). small models can be sensitive.

tess: index params are identical, ef_search=128, M=16. confirmed.

omar: recommended action: if mixed-precision keeps recall within -1% and humans accept, add a model-catalog flag precision_override: {"final_proj":"fp16"} and add a note to rollout docs. else default to heron-v2 for short-query endpoints.

cassie: i'll draft the onboarding note and mitigation steps. include commands used and dataset slices.

eval-bot: final note: keep staging blocked until human review completes. posting status when reviewers finish.

tess: thanks everyone. pushing this thread into the onboarding doc with results + artifacts. pausing here. :wave:
